description: Baluchistan Glass Limited is a glass-container manufacturer incorporated in Pakistan in 1980 and listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange. It is a company of the Gharibwal Group and supplies glass packaging to the food, beverage and pharmaceutical industries, alongside glass tableware and plastic shells. Manufacturing is at H.I.T.E. in Hub, Balochistan; the head office is on Sheikhupura Road near Lahore. Its quality management system is certified to ISO 9001.
headOffice: 12-KM Sheikhupura Road, Kot Abdul Malik, District Lahore, Pakistan
